contentList.content: Novice

A soul reborn out of sequence, the Novice remembers fragments of another life: the training fields of Rune-Midgard, the climb from first job to second, and the solemn rite before the Valkyrie. Stripped of title, coin, and relic, they awaken in the Forgotten Realms with nothing but discipline and instinct. Their old techniques survive as rough muscle memory, but this world is different, crueler, and stranger. Every battle is a lesson, every companion a new chapter, and every choice a step toward becoming something greater than they were before.
Mana Points
The spiritual reserve used to perform Ragnarok-style techniques.
Not enough Mana Points.
Basic Skill
Novice training from Rune-Midgard. Grants proficiency with Daggers, Shortswords, Clubs, and Shortbows.
Play Dead
Feign death for 4 turns. Costs 3 Mana Points. Usable once per Short Rest.
First Aid
A close-range emergency treatment. Heal a creature for 1d4 Hit Points. Costs 2 Mana Points.
First Aid
Unlocks First Aid (1d4 healing).
First Aid improves to 1d6 healing at Novice level 5.
First Aid improves to 1d8 healing at Novice level 9.
Valkyrie's Blessing
When you roll a 1 for an Attack Roll, Ability Check, or Saving Throw, reroll the die once and use the new result.
Archer
A disciplined marksman path adapted from Rune-Midgard traditions. This first job establishes ranged fundamentals and uses Wisdom-based Mana growth.
Owl's Eye
Unlocks the Owl's Eye precision stance. Spend 1 Mana Point as a Bonus Action to gain +2 to attack rolls and reduce your critical hit threshold by 1.
Adopt a precision stance, reading the target's movement for more accurate shots. Gain +2 to attack rolls and reduce your critical hit threshold by 1 until your next Short Rest. Costs 1 Mana Point.
Precision stance active. +2 to attack rolls. Critical hits on a 19 or 20.
Owl's Eye
Leave your Owl's Eye precision stance.
Vulture's Eye
Unlocks the Vulture's Eye pressure stance. Spend 1 Mana Point as a Bonus Action to ignore point-blank disadvantage with crossbows and deal +1d4 weapon damage against targets beyond 10m.

Adopt a long-range pressure stance focused on distant targets. Ignore point-blank disadvantage with crossbows and deal +1d4 weapon damage to targets beyond 10m until your next Short Rest. Costs 1 Mana Point.
Long-range pressure stance active. Ignore point-blank disadvantage with crossbows and deal +1d4 weapon damage beyond 10m.
Vulture's Eye
Leave your Vulture's Eye pressure stance.
Double Strafe
Unlocks Double Strafe. Fire two rapid shots at the same target using your ranged weapon. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Fire two quick shots at the same target. Each hit deals normal ranged weapon damage and applies weapon on-hit effects. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Fire two quick shots at the same target. Each hit deals normal ranged weapon damage plus 1d4 bonus damage. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Fire two quick shots at the same target. Each hit deals normal ranged weapon damage plus 1d6 bonus damage. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Fire two quick shots at the same target. Each hit deals normal ranged weapon damage plus 1d8 bonus damage. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Double Strafe improves to +1d4 bonus damage per hit at Archer level 5.
Double Strafe improves to +1d6 bonus damage per hit at Archer level 9.
Double Strafe improves to +1d8 bonus damage per hit at Archer level 12.
Arrow Crafting
Unlocks Arrow Crafting. Prepare special arrows with 2 charges (1d4 bonus damage) for your next successful ranged hits.
Arrow Crafting improves at Archer level 5: 1d6 bonus damage and secondary effects on failed Constitution save for 2 turns.
Arrow Crafting improves at Archer level 9: 3 charges.
Arrow Crafting improves at Archer level 12: 1d8 bonus damage per empowered hit.

Prepare Fire Arrow for 2 turns. Your next successful ranged hits consume charges and deal +1d4 Fire damage.
Prepare Fire Arrow for 2 turns. Your next successful ranged hits consume charges and deal +1d6 Fire damage. On failed CON save, inflicts BURNING for 2 turns.
Prepare Fire Arrow for 2 turns. Your next successful ranged hits consume charges and deal +1d6 Fire damage. On failed CON save, inflicts BURNING for 2 turns.
Prepare Fire Arrow for 2 turns. Your next successful ranged hits consume charges and deal +1d8 Fire damage. On failed CON save, inflicts BURNING for 2 turns.

Prepare Poison Arrow for 2 turns. Your next successful ranged hits consume charges and deal +1d4 Poison damage.
Prepare Poison Arrow for 2 turns. Your next successful ranged hits consume charges and deal +1d6 Poison damage. On failed CON save, inflicts POISONED for 2 turns.
Prepare Poison Arrow for 2 turns. Your next successful ranged hits consume charges and deal +1d6 Poison damage. On failed CON save, inflicts POISONED for 2 turns.
Prepare Poison Arrow for 2 turns. Your next successful ranged hits consume charges and deal +1d8 Poison damage. On failed CON save, inflicts POISONED for 2 turns.
Shock Arrow
Prepare Shock Arrow for 2 turns. Your next successful ranged hits consume charges and deal +1d4 Lightning damage.
Prepare Shock Arrow for 2 turns. Your next successful ranged hits consume charges and deal +1d6 Lightning damage. On failed CON save, inflicts SHOCKED for 2 turns.
Prepare Shock Arrow for 2 turns. Your next successful ranged hits consume charges and deal +1d6 Lightning damage. On failed CON save, inflicts SHOCKED for 2 turns.
Prepare Shock Arrow for 2 turns. Your next successful ranged hits consume charges and deal +1d8 Lightning damage. On failed CON save, inflicts SHOCKED for 2 turns.
Radiant Arrow
Prepare Radiant Arrow for 2 turns. Your next successful ranged hits consume charges and deal +1d4 Radiant damage.
Prepare Radiant Arrow for 2 turns. Your next successful ranged hits consume charges and deal +1d6 Radiant damage. On failed CON save, inflicts DAZED for 2 turns.
Prepare Radiant Arrow for 2 turns. Your next successful ranged hits consume charges and deal +1d6 Radiant damage. On failed CON save, inflicts DAZED for 2 turns.
Prepare Radiant Arrow for 2 turns. Your next successful ranged hits consume charges and deal +1d8 Radiant damage. On failed CON save, inflicts DAZED for 2 turns.
Improve Concentration
Unlocks Improve Concentration. Spend 3 Mana Points as a Bonus Action to enter concentration for 2 turns, gaining +1 to ranged attack rolls and +1 AC.
Improve Concentration improves at Archer level 6: +2 ranged attack rolls and +2 AC.
Improve Concentration improves at Archer level 9: duration increases to 3 turns.
Improve Concentration improves at Archer level 12: Double Strafe costs 1 less Mana Point (minimum 1).
Focus your breathing and stance under pressure. For 2 turns, gain +1 to ranged attack rolls and +1 AC while maintaining Concentration. Costs 3 Mana Points.
Focus your breathing and stance under pressure. For 2 turns, gain +2 to ranged attack rolls and +2 AC while maintaining Concentration. Costs 3 Mana Points.
Focus your breathing and stance under pressure. For 3 turns, gain +2 to ranged attack rolls and +2 AC while maintaining Concentration. Costs 3 Mana Points.

Focus your breathing and stance under pressure. For 3 turns, gain +2 to ranged attack rolls and +2 AC while maintaining Concentration. Your Double Strafe also costs 1 less Mana Point (minimum 1). Costs 3 Mana Points.
Concentration maintained: +1 to ranged attack rolls and +1 AC.
Concentration maintained: +2 to ranged attack rolls and +2 AC.
Concentration maintained: +2 to ranged attack rolls and +2 AC. Duration increased.
Concentration maintained: +2 to ranged attack rolls and +2 AC. Double Strafe MP efficiency improved.
Arrow Shower
Unleash a 60-degree cone of arrows (10m). Each enemy hit takes ranged weapon damage +1d4 and must pass a Strength save or be pushed 2m. Costs 4 Mana Points.
Unleash a 75-degree cone of arrows (10m). Each enemy hit takes ranged weapon damage +1d6 and must pass a Strength save or be pushed 2m. Costs 4 Mana Points.
Unleash a 90-degree cone of arrows (15m). Each enemy hit takes ranged weapon damage +1d8 and must pass a Strength save or be pushed 2m. Costs 4 Mana Points.
Arrow Repel
Repel a nearby enemy with a close-range shot. On hit, deal ranged weapon damage +1d4 and push the target 3m. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Repel a nearby enemy with a close-range shot made with Advantage. On hit, deal ranged weapon damage +1d6 and push the target 4m. Costs 2 Mana Points.

Repel a nearby enemy with a close-range shot made with Advantage. On hit, deal ranged weapon damage +1d8 and push the target 4m. On failed CON save, inflict Chest Trauma for 2 turns. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Unlocks Arrow Repel. Close-range ranged strike that pushes enemies back 3m and deals +1d4 bonus damage. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Arrow Repel improves at Archer level 9: push increases to 4m, bonus damage becomes +1d6, and the attack is made with Advantage.
Arrow Repel improves at Archer level 12: bonus damage becomes +1d8 and failed CON save applies Chest Trauma for 2 turns.
Magician
A fragile first-job caster from Rune-Midgard focused on elemental control and Intelligence-based Mana growth.
Element Bolt - Force
Launch a condensed force bolt. Gain +1 to the attack roll; on hit deal 2d4 + spellcasting modifier Force damage. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Element Bolt
Unlocks Element Bolt Overchannel variants for Magician: Force, Fire, Cold, and Lightning in Base (2 MP), Intensified (3 MP), and Overload (4 MP).
Element Bolt - Force (Intensified)
Element Bolt (Force, Intensified): adds +1 damage per die to this cast (2d4 becomes 2d4+2), then + spellcasting modifier. Costs 3 Mana Points.
Element Bolt - Force (Overload)
Element Bolt (Force, Overload): gain +1 to the attack roll. On hit, damage is resolved as if the target were vulnerable to Force (double Force damage). Costs 4 Mana Points.
Element Bolt - Fire
Launch a condensed fire bolt. Gain +1 to the attack roll; on hit deal 2d4 + spellcasting modifier Fire damage. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Element Bolt - Fire (Intensified)
Element Bolt (Fire, Intensified): if the hit lands, the target becomes Burning for 2 turns. Costs 3 Mana Points.
Element Bolt - Fire (Overload)
Element Bolt (Fire, Overload): gain +1 to the attack roll; on hit applies Burning for 2 turns and an extra burst of Fire damage to represent Burning Fiercely. Costs 4 Mana Points.
Element Bolt - Cold
Launch a condensed cold bolt. Gain +1 to the attack roll; on hit deal 2d4 + spellcasting modifier Cold damage. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Element Bolt - Cold (Intensified)
Element Bolt (Cold, Intensified): if the hit lands, the target becomes Chilled for 2 turns. Costs 3 Mana Points.
Element Bolt - Cold (Overload)
Element Bolt (Cold, Overload): gain +1 to the attack roll; on hit applies Chilled and Ensnared for 2 turns. Costs 4 Mana Points.
Element Bolt - Lightning
Launch a condensed lightning bolt. Gain +1 to the attack roll; on hit deal 2d4 + spellcasting modifier Lightning damage. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Element Bolt - Lightning (Intensified)
Element Bolt (Lightning, Intensified): if the hit lands, the target becomes Shocked for 2 turns. Costs 3 Mana Points.
Element Bolt - Lightning (Overload)
Element Bolt (Lightning, Overload): gain +1 to the attack roll; on hit applies Shocked for 2 turns, then arcs one extra impact to a secondary enemy within 5m when available. Costs 4 Mana Points.
Element Bolt - Base
Choose an element for a base Element Bolt cast (2 MP).
Element Bolt - Intensified
Choose an element for an intensified Element Bolt cast (3 MP).
Element Bolt - Overload
Choose an element for an overload Element Bolt cast (4 MP).
Increase Spiritual Power
Deepens your spiritual reserve. Maximum Mana Points increase by 2.
Increase Spiritual Power improves at Magician level 5: maximum Mana Points increase by 4.
Increase Spiritual Power improves at Magician level 9: maximum Mana Points increase by 6.
Increase Spiritual Power improves at Magician level 12: maximum Mana Points increase by 8.
Sight
Unlocks Sight. Spend 1 Mana Point as a Bonus Action to reveal hidden and invisible enemies around you in a 6m aura for 3 turns.
Sight improves at Magician level 9: duration increases to 4 turns.
Sight improves at Magician level 12: reveal aura radius increases to 9m.
Sight
Disturb light and illusion around you. For 3 turns, reveal hidden and invisible enemies in a 6m aura. Costs 1 Mana Point.
Disturb light and illusion around you. For 4 turns, reveal hidden and invisible enemies in a 6m aura. Costs 1 Mana Point.
Disturb light and illusion around you. For 4 turns, reveal hidden and invisible enemies in a 9m aura. Costs 1 Mana Point.
Frost Diver
Unlocks Frost Diver. Deal 2d6 + spellcasting modifier Cold damage; target must pass a Constitution save or become Frozen for 1 turn. Costs 4 Mana Points.
Frost Diver improves at Magician level 9: damage becomes 3d6 + spellcasting modifier and Frozen duration becomes 2 turns.
Frost Diver improves at Magician level 12: damage becomes 4d6 + spellcasting modifier.
Blast a target with violent cold. Deal 2d6 + spellcasting modifier Cold damage. On failed Constitution save, the target becomes Frozen for 1 turn. Costs 4 Mana Points.
Blast a target with violent cold. Deal 3d6 + spellcasting modifier Cold damage. On failed Constitution save, the target becomes Frozen for 2 turns. Costs 4 Mana Points.
Blast a target with violent cold. Deal 4d6 + spellcasting modifier Cold damage. On failed Constitution save, the target becomes Frozen for 2 turns. Costs 4 Mana Points.
Stone Curse
Unlocks Stone Curse. Target must pass a Constitution save or become Restrained for 2 turns. Costs 3 Mana Points.
Stone Curse improves at Magician level 6: on failed primary save, target must pass a second Constitution save or become Incapacitated until the end of its next turn.
Stone Curse improves at Magician level 9: while cursed, the target takes an extra 1d4 bludgeoning damage whenever hit by a physical attack.
Stone Curse improves at Magician level 12: Restrained duration increases to 3 turns (other Stone Curse penalties retained).
Attempt to petrify a target with arcane mineral force. On failed Constitution save, the target becomes Restrained for 2 turns. Costs 3 Mana Points.

Attempt to petrify a target with arcane mineral force. On failed Constitution save, the target becomes Restrained for 2 turns. Then it must pass a second Constitution save or become Incapacitated until the end of its next turn. Costs 3 Mana Points.

Attempt to petrify a target with arcane mineral force. On failed Constitution save, the target becomes Restrained for 2 turns. Then it must pass a second Constitution save or become Incapacitated until the end of its next turn. While cursed, the target also takes an extra 1d4 bludgeoning damage whenever hit by a physical attack. Costs 3 Mana Points.

Attempt to petrify a target with arcane mineral force. On failed Constitution save, the target becomes Restrained for 3 turns. Then it must pass a second Constitution save or become Incapacitated until the end of its next turn. While cursed, the target also takes an extra 1d4 bludgeoning damage whenever hit by a physical attack. Costs 3 Mana Points.
Energy Coat
Unlocks Energy Coat. Spend 2 Mana Points as a Bonus Action to gain a protective coat for 2 turns (Concentration), reducing incoming damage and consuming MP when hit.
Energy Coat improves at Magician level 9: damage reduction increases.
Energy Coat improves at Magician level 12: damage reduction increases further.
Wrap yourself in arcane force. For 2 turns, reduce incoming damage by 4 and consume 1 Mana Point each time you are hit. Concentration.
Wrap yourself in arcane force. For 2 turns, reduce incoming damage by 6 and consume 1 Mana Point each time you are hit. Concentration.
Wrap yourself in arcane force. For 2 turns, reduce incoming damage by 8 and consume 1 Mana Point each time you are hit. Concentration.
Damage reduction active: -4 incoming damage. Consumes 1 Mana Point when hit.
Damage reduction active: -6 incoming damage. Consumes 1 Mana Point when hit.
Damage reduction active: -8 incoming damage. Consumes 1 Mana Point when hit.
Safety Wall
Unlocks Safety Wall. Protect yourself or an ally with a barrier that negates 3 incoming melee hits for 3 turns (Concentration).
Safety Wall improves at Magician level 6: negates 4 incoming melee hits.
Safety Wall improves at Magician level 9: duration increases to 4 turns and negates 5 incoming melee hits.
Safety Wall improves at Magician level 12: negates 6 incoming melee hits.
Create a protective barrier on yourself or an ally. For 3 turns, it negates up to 3 incoming melee hits. Costs 4 Mana Points. Concentration.
Create a protective barrier on yourself or an ally. For 3 turns, it negates up to 4 incoming melee hits. Costs 4 Mana Points. Concentration.
Create a protective barrier on yourself or an ally. For 4 turns, it negates up to 5 incoming melee hits. Costs 4 Mana Points. Concentration.
Create a protective barrier on yourself or an ally. For 3 turns, it negates up to 6 incoming melee hits. Costs 4 Mana Points. Concentration.
Protected by a safety wall. Negates incoming melee hits while charges remain.
Element AoE
Unlocks Element AoE. Choose Fire or Lightning in Base (4 MP), Intensified (5 MP), or Overload (6 MP).
Element AoE improves at Magician level 9: base damage increases.
Element AoE improves at Magician level 12: area radius increases and damage improves again.
Element AoE - Base
Choose Fire or Lightning Element AoE (Base). Costs 4 Mana Points.
Element AoE - Intensified
Choose Fire or Lightning Element AoE (Intensified). Costs 5 Mana Points.
Element AoE - Overload
Choose Fire or Lightning Element AoE (Overload). Costs 6 Mana Points.
Element AoE - Fire
Explode a 3m circular area with fire. Deals 3d6 + spellcasting modifier Fire damage. Costs 4 Mana Points.
Element AoE - Fire (Intensified)
Explode a 3m circular area with fire. Deals 3d6 + spellcasting modifier Fire damage. Targets must pass a Constitution save or become Burning for 1 turn. Costs 5 Mana Points.
Element AoE - Fire (Overload)
Explode a 3m circular area with fire. Deals 3d6 + spellcasting modifier Fire damage, applies Burning on failed Constitution save, and adds 1d4 Fire damage. Costs 6 Mana Points.
Element AoE - Lightning
Detonate a 3m circular lightning area. Deals 2d6 Lightning damage. Costs 4 Mana Points.
Element AoE - Lightning (Intensified)
Detonate a 3m circular lightning area. Deals 2d6 Lightning damage. Targets struck must pass a Constitution save or become Shocked for 1 turn. Costs 5 Mana Points.
Element AoE - Lightning (Overload)
Detonate a 3m circular lightning area. Deals 2d6 Lightning damage, applies Shocked on failed Constitution save, and deals an extra 1d4 Lightning to Shocked targets. Costs 6 Mana Points.
Fire Wall
Unlocks Fire Wall. Place a flaming barrier line up to 6m long within 12m. Lasts 2 turns and scorches enemies that cross or end turn in it. Costs 4 Mana Points. Concentration.
Fire Wall improves at Magician level 9: wall damage increases to 6d8.
Fire Wall improves at Magician level 12: wall damage increases to 7d8, wall length increases to 8m, and duration increases to 3 turns.
Fire Wall
Create a wall of fire up to 6m long within 12m. The wall lasts 2 turns and deals 5d8 Fire damage to enemies that cross it or end their turn in it. Costs 4 Mana Points. Concentration.
Create a wall of fire up to 6m long within 12m. The wall lasts 2 turns and deals 6d8 Fire damage to enemies that cross it or end their turn in it. Costs 4 Mana Points. Concentration.
Create a wall of fire up to 8m long within 12m. The wall lasts 3 turns and deals 7d8 Fire damage to enemies that cross it or end their turn in it. Costs 4 Mana Points. Concentration.
Acolyte

A devoted first-job support from Rune-Midgard who channels sacred rites through Wisdom. Acolytes protect allies, cleanse afflictions, and punish profane foes while growing Mana through disciplined faith.
Sacred Doctrine
Unlocks Sacred Doctrine stances. Spend 1 Mana Point as a Bonus Action to adopt Divine Protection or Demon Bane.
Divine Protection
Adopt a protective doctrine. Gain flat reduction against physical damage while active. Costs 1 Mana Point.
Leave Divine Protection.
Demon Bane
Adopt an offensive doctrine. Gain +1 flat bonus damage while active. Costs 1 Mana Point.
Leave Demon Bane.
Divine Protection
Doctrine active: reduce incoming Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning damage by 2.
Demon Bane
Doctrine active: gain +1 flat damage.
Ninja
A high-mobility first-job skirmisher from Rune-Midgard who blends stealth weapon arts with Intelligence-driven ninpou discipline.
Ninja Training
Choose your active ninja discipline. Only one can be active at a time.
Throwing Mastery
Adopt Throwing Mastery. Gain +1 attack rolls with thrown techniques, and +1 additional against conditioned targets, until your next Short Rest.
Leave Throwing Mastery.
Shadow Arts
Adopt Shadow Arts. Gain +3m movement while active until your next Short Rest.
Leave Shadow Arts.
Ninpou Training
Adopt Ninpou Training. Gain +1 Spell Attack and +1 Spell Save DC while active until your next Short Rest.
Leave Ninpou Training.
Throwing Mastery
Discipline active until your next Short Rest: +1 attack rolls with thrown techniques (+1 additional vs conditioned targets).
Shadow Arts
Discipline active until your next Short Rest: gain +3m movement.
Ninpou Training
Discipline active until your next Short Rest: +1 Spell Attack and +1 Spell Save DC.
Cancel Training
Deactivate your current ninja discipline.
Thrown Technique
Choose one technique: Throw Shuriken, Throw Kunai, or Throw Huuma Shuriken. Costs 1 Mana Point.
Throw Shuriken
Throw a shuriken at a target within 18m. Deals 1d6 + Dexterity Modifier Piercing damage, plus 1d4 against conditioned targets. Costs 1 Mana Point.
Throw Kunai
Throw a kunai at a target within 10m. Deals 1d8 + Dexterity Modifier Piercing damage; on failed CON save, applies Reeling for 2 turns (-1 Attack Rolls). Costs 1 Mana Point.
Throw Huuma Shuriken
Launch a heavy huuma shuriken at a target within 10m, impacting a 3m area. Deals 2d6 + Dexterity Modifier Piercing damage, plus 1d4 against conditioned targets. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Thrown Technique improves at level 5: Shuriken 1d8 (+1d6 vs conditioned), Kunai 1d10 (Reeling 3 turns), Huuma 3d6 (+1d6 vs conditioned).
Throw a shuriken at a target within 18m. Deals 1d8 + Dexterity Modifier Piercing damage, plus 1d6 against conditioned targets. Costs 1 Mana Point.
Throw a kunai at a target within 10m. Deals 1d10 + Dexterity Modifier Piercing damage; on failed CON save, applies Reeling for 3 turns (-1 Attack Rolls). Costs 1 Mana Point.
Launch a heavy huuma shuriken at a target within 10m, impacting a 4m area. Deals 3d6 + Dexterity Modifier Piercing damage, plus 1d6 against conditioned targets. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Thrown Technique improves at level 9: Shuriken 2d8 (+1d8 vs conditioned), Kunai 2d10 (Reeling), Huuma 4d6 (+1d8 vs conditioned, can inflict Off Balance).
Throw a shuriken at a target within 18m. Deals 2d8 + Dexterity Modifier Piercing damage, plus 1d8 against conditioned targets. Costs 1 Mana Point.
Throw a kunai at a target within 10m. Deals 2d10 + Dexterity Modifier Piercing damage; on failed CON save, applies Reeling for 3 turns (-1 Attack Rolls). Costs 1 Mana Point.

Launch a heavy huuma shuriken at a target within 10m, impacting a 4m area. Deals 4d6 + Dexterity Modifier Piercing damage, plus 1d8 against conditioned targets; conditioned targets that fail STR save become Off Balance. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Thrown Technique
Unlocks Thrown Technique (Shuriken/Kunai/Huuma) at Ninja level 2.
Thrown Technique damage improves at Ninja level 5.
Thrown Technique damage improves at Ninja level 9, with stronger conditioned payoffs and Kunai Reeling pressure.
Reeling
Thrown off balance by kunai impact: -1 Attack Rolls.
Shadow Jump
Teleport through shadows up to 9m. Your next attack or technique this turn gains +1 Attack Roll. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Teleport through shadows up to 12m. Your next attack or technique this turn gains +1 Attack Roll. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Teleport through shadows up to 15m. Your next attack or technique this turn gains +2 Attack Roll and +1d6 bonus damage. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Unlocks Shadow Jump at Ninja level 2.
Shadow Jump improves at Ninja level 5.
Shadow Jump improves at Ninja level 9 (+2 Attack Roll on next hit and +1d6 bonus damage).
Shadow Jump Momentum
After Shadow Jump, gain +1 Attack Roll on your next attack or technique this turn.
Shadow Jump Momentum+
After Shadow Jump, gain +2 Attack Roll and +1d6 bonus damage on your next attack or technique this turn.
Mist Slash
Slash a target within 6m with a mist-infused strike. Reposition 3m after hit without provoking opportunity attacks. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Slash a target within 6m. Deals weapon damage +1d6 and grants 3m safe reposition after hit. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Slash a target within 6m. Deals weapon damage +2d6, gains +1 Attack Roll, and grants 3m safe reposition after hit. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Unlocks Mist Slash at Ninja level 3.
Mist Slash improves at Ninja level 5.
Mist Slash improves at Ninja level 9.
Mist Reposition
After landing Mist Slash, gain 3m movement and move without provoking opportunity attacks this turn.
Crimson Fire Blossom
Launch a focused fire ninpou bolt at a target within 18m. Deals 2d6 + Intelligence Modifier Fire damage. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Lightning Spear of Ice
Launch a focused ice ninpou bolt at a target within 18m. Deals 2d6 + Intelligence Modifier Cold damage. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Wind Blade
Launch a focused wind ninpou bolt at a target within 18m. Deals 2d6 + Intelligence Modifier Thunder damage. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Launch a focused fire ninpou bolt at a target within 18m. Deals 3d6 + Intelligence Modifier Fire damage. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Launch a focused ice ninpou bolt at a target within 18m. Deals 3d6 + Intelligence Modifier Cold damage. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Launch a focused wind ninpou bolt at a target within 18m. Deals 3d6 + Intelligence Modifier Thunder damage. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Launch a focused fire ninpou bolt at a target within 18m. Deals 4d6 + Intelligence Modifier Fire damage. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Launch a focused ice ninpou bolt at a target within 18m. Deals 4d6 + Intelligence Modifier Cold damage. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Launch a focused wind ninpou bolt at a target within 18m. Deals 4d6 + Intelligence Modifier Thunder damage. Costs 2 Mana Points.
Ninpou Bolt
Unlocks Ninpou Bolt variants (Crimson Fire Blossom, Lightning Spear of Ice, Wind Blade) at Ninja level 3.
Ninpou Bolt improves at Ninja level 5.
Ninpou Bolt improves at Ninja level 9.
